question: Shivnath Mishra is an exponent of Benaras Gharana and he plays the _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shivnath Mishra is an exponent of the Benaras Gharana, which is one of the prominent schools of Indian classical music.
 
• The Benaras Gharana is known for its unique style and techniques in playing various musical instruments.
 
• Shivnath Mishra specializes in playing the Sitar, a plucked stringed instrument used in Indian classical music.
 
• The Sitar has a rich and melodious sound, making it a popular choice among classical musicians.
 
• Shivnath Mishra has contributed significantly to the field of Indian classical music through his expertise in the Sitar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Benaras Gharana**

 
 
• It is also known as the Banaras or Varanasi Gharana.
 
• This Gharana is famous for its vocal and instrumental music styles, particularly in the genres of Thumri, Dadra, and Khayal.
 
 
 
• **Sitar**
 
 
• The Sitar is a long-necked instrument with a gourd resonating chamber, used widely in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It typically has 18-21 strings, including both playing and sympathetic strings.
 
 
 
• **Other Instruments in Indian Classical Music**
 
 
• **Tabla:** A pair of hand drums used for rhythm in Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Rudra Veena:** An ancient stringed instrument, considered a precursor to the Sitar.
 
• **Harmonium:** A free-reed organ that produces sound as air flows past a vibrating piece of thin metal in a frame, widely used in Indian classical and devotional music.
